skill.name: geo-generate
skill.description: Generate reviewable llms.txt proposals, candidate JSON-LD, and crawler-control suggestions for an authorized website build.
skill.summary: Preview and review optional discovery artifacts before applying them to a website.
skill.author: cucuwang

security_audit.summary: All eight static findings are false positives. The cited backticks are Markdown fences or inline code markers in SKILL.md, and no executable Ruby or shell backtick expression is present. No prompt injection or additional semantic security finding was identified.

remediation.issue: The workflow uses npx to invoke the generator.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify the intended geoptimize package version before use, and run it only against an authorized directory after reviewing dry-run output.

static_findings.snippet: - `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` are experiments based on a proposal.
- Candidate `Article` or `BreadcrumbList` JSON-LD must match visible content.
- Never add `<link rel="llms-txt">` as if it were a standardized discovery mechanism.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 15 is a Markdown bash code-fence marker, not Ruby backtick execution. The file contains documentation formatting rather than an executable expression.
Line 17 closes a Markdown code block and does not execute a command. The surrounding content is instructional documentation.
The backticks on line 20 delimit inline filenames in Markdown. They are not Ruby or shell execution syntax in this SKILL.md document.
The backticks on line 21 format an inline JSON-LD term in prose. No executable backtick expression is present.
Line 25 is a Markdown bash code-fence marker. It only begins a documented command example and is not itself code execution.
Line 27 closes a Markdown code block after the documented command. It is formatting, not Ruby or shell backtick execution.
The backticks on line 32 mark FAQPage as inline code in a prohibition. They do not invoke an external command.

content.value_statement: Website teams need a careful way to explore emerging discovery files and structured data. This skill previews candidate artifacts and keeps approval with the user before writing changes.
actual_capabilities: Identifies an authorized static website build directory.
Runs a dry-run generation preview before writing artifacts.
Previews llms.txt and llms-full.txt candidate files.
Reviews Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD against visible content.
Requires approval of the exact directory before writing.
limitations: It does not guarantee crawling, indexing, ranking, visibility, or citations.
It does not make crawler rules consistent across services.
It does not infer FAQPage structured data from question headings.
It does not automatically apply robots.txt suggestions.

use_cases.title: Review Discovery Proposals
use_cases.description: Preview optional llms.txt files and assess whether they accurately represent a static website before approval.

use_cases.title: Check Structured Data
use_cases.description: Compare candidate Article or BreadcrumbList markup with visible page content during a documentation or publishing review.

use_cases.title: Audit Crawler Controls
use_cases.description: Inspect crawler-control suggestions and deployment boundaries without assuming that an allow rule guarantees service behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Preview a Website
prompt_templates.prompt: Use geo-generate to preview discovery artifacts for my authorized static build directory. Do not write any files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review before the first generation run

prompt_templates.title: Review llms.txt Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview the llms.txt and llms-full.txt candidates for my approved website directory. Summarize their purpose and identify claims that need review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Content review for an existing website

prompt_templates.title: Validate Structured Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a dry-run preview for my authorized build directory, then check each Article and BreadcrumbList candidate against the visible content. Flag mismatches.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Controlled Write
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a dry-run first for the exact authorized directory. Review crawler-control suggestions, confirm that no existing artifact will be overwritten without a recoverable copy, and wait for my approval before writing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced deployment preparation with change control

output_examples.input: Preview discovery artifacts for an authorized static build directory.
output_examples.output: A dry-run review containing proposed llms.txt files, candidate structured data, and crawler-control suggestions. No files are written.

output_examples.input: Check whether a candidate BreadcrumbList matches the published page.
output_examples.output: A review that compares the candidate hierarchy with visible content and identifies any mismatch requiring correction.
A confirmation request for the exact directory and a reminder to preserve existing artifacts before any write operation.

best_practices: Use an authorized static build directory and start with a dry-run preview.
Compare every structured-data candidate with visible page content.
Keep a recoverable copy and obtain approval before writing artifacts.
anti_patterns: Treating llms.txt as a guaranteed search or citation mechanism.
Applying robots.txt suggestions automatically or without service-specific review.
Adding FAQPage markup from headings alone or presenting llms.txt as a standardized link relation.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It previews optional llms.txt files, candidate JSON-LD, and crawler-control suggestions for a website build.

faq.question: Does the skill write files immediately?
faq.answer: No. It begins with a dry-run and requires approval of the exact directory before writing.

faq.question: Does llms.txt guarantee AI search visibility?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that these files do not guarantee crawling, indexing, visibility, or citations.

faq.question: Which structured data does it review?
faq.answer: It reviews candidate Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD against visible content.

faq.question: Can it apply robots.txt suggestions automatically?
faq.answer: No. The workflow explicitly forbids automatic application of robots.txt suggestions.

faq.question: Should I use a link relation for llms.txt?
faq.answer: No. The skill warns that llms.txt is not a standardized discovery mechanism through an HTML link relation.
